name: Starter
description: A neutral, light starter site with 23 general-purpose sections composed into four pages — Home, Pricing, About and Contact — plus a library of 75 more blocks in the Add Section picker: five each of heroes, headers, logos, features, stats, testimonials, pricing, FAQ, CTA, footers, blog, contact, team, newsletter and about, every one drawn in the same system with its own copy and product screenshots.
tagline: A neutral light starter with 98 sections
